brand.name: Kiln Row Collective
brand.descriptor: A members' studio and community for independent makers and small creative businesses in Bristol.

text.eyebrow: For independent makers and small creative businesses in Bristol
text.heading: A shared studio and a community that has your back
text.body: Kiln Row Collective gives makers, designers and small creative businesses a working studio, kiln access, and a community that shows up for each other's launches.

items.title: 24-hour studio access
items.blurb: Badge in any time, day or night, to bench space, kiln slots and shared tools.

items.title: Kiln and equipment access
items.blurb: Two electric kilns, a spray booth and a wood shop, booked through the members' calendar.

items.title: A working community
items.blurb: Critique nights, skill shares and a group that actually looks at your work.

items.title: Discounted workshops
items.blurb: Half price on every workshop the studio runs, for you and one guest.

text.heading: Membership tiers
text.body: Pick the level of access that matches how often you're in the studio.

items.name: Studio Day
items.description: Drop-in bench time for occasional use.

items.name: Full Bench
items.description: A dedicated bench and regular kiln slots.

items.name: Studio Partner
items.description: For a small creative business based at Kiln Row.

items.title: Visit the studio
items.body: Come by on a Tuesday open night and see the space before you commit.

items.title: Pick a tier
items.body: Choose Studio Day, Full Bench or a partner bench, based on how often you'll be in.

items.title: Get your induction
items.body: A 30-minute kiln and safety induction, then you're badged in.

items.title: Open critique night
items.blurb: Bring current work for a group look, no RSVP needed.

items.title: Glaze chemistry workshop
items.blurb: A half-day workshop on mixing your own glazes, led by a member.

items.title: Winter open studios
items.blurb: Members open their benches to the public for one weekend.

items.quote: I moved my whole practice here in a month and never looked back.
items.name: Priya Odedra

items.quote: The kiln access alone pays for the membership.
items.name: Femi Adeyemi

items.quote: Having other makers around changed how seriously I take my own work.
items.name: Elin Karlsson

items.question: Do I need my own tools?
items.answer: No. Shared hand tools and machines are included; bring your own only if you prefer.

items.question: Can I pause my membership?
items.answer: Yes, pause for up to two months a year with two weeks' notice.

items.question: Is there a joining fee?
items.answer: No joining fee. You pay the first month's membership and that's it.

items.question: Can I bring a guest?
items.answer: Members can bring a guest to open nights and workshops at no extra charge.

text.heading: Ready to join Kiln Row?
text.body: Tell us what you make and how often you'd use the studio. We reply within two working days.

text.tagline: A members' studio and community for independent makers in Bristol.
